decisions.reason: After several years without a clear negative signal, this close extension of the core heat-exchanger range looks inexpensive to maintain and still strategically attractive in HVAC, so we would keep it.
Its strong fit with the firm's marine cooling business and earlier indication of quality recognition and market share make withdrawal very unlikely, so we would keep it.

As a marine cooling product built on existing capabilities, it remains a reasonable option to retain because continued presence suggests acceptable value and the cost of keeping it open is likely limited.
Enhanced exchanger tubes are technologically close to the firm's core offer and useful for learning and cross-selling, so absent clear failure evidence we would keep the option alive.
